f(x,y) = x in the segment [−1,1]. g(s) = (s,0) in the disk.
On the disk, g∘f(x,y) = (x,0), and H((x,y),t) = (x,(1−t)y) stays in the disk and moves (x,y) to its round-trip image (x,0). On the segment, f∘g(s) = s exactly.

The top and bottom Y pictures show exactly the same intermediate output. The homotopy is in X: at t = 0 it matches the original input above, and at t = 1 it matches the composition below. The homotopy need not be one-to-one.
